dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Your date of birth is June 5th, 2006. Is that correct?
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˌdeɪt əv ˈbɜːrθ ɪz ˈdʒuːn ˈfɪfθ, ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈsɪks. ɪz ˈðæt kəˈrɛkt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: ənd jʊr ˈfoʊn ˌnʌmbər ɪz ˈzɪroʊ ˈnaɪn ˈeɪt, ˈsɛvən ˈsɪks ˈfaɪv, ˈfɔːr ˈθriː ˈwʌn ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, can you say that again?
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, kən juː ˈseɪ ðæt əˈɡɛn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Zero nine eight, seven six five, four three one two.
dialogue.reading: ˈzɪroʊ ˈnaɪn ˈeɪt, ˈsɛvən ˈsɪks ˈfaɪv, ˈfɔːr ˈθriː ˈwʌn ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it's four three two one.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ˈfɔːr ˈθriː ˈtuː ˈwʌn.
